text:
kevin: main CI turned red after my merge (PR #4321). Only failing the py-integration matrix shard (index 2). Logs show a db-setup timeout, unsure if infra or test flake.

sam: can you paste the failing run link? I can try a targeted rerun without rebuilding images.

kevin: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/1234567890 :eyes:

maya: if you want to avoid image rebuild, use gh CLI: 
```
# try rerunning the specific job (job name may vary)
gh run rerun 1234567890 --job "py-integration[2]"
```
But GH sometimes needs job_id; fallback: 
```
gh api -X POST /repos/:owner/:repo/actions/runs/1234567890/rerun -f job_id=9876543
```

sam: or use our bot shortcut: `@ci-bot rerun run=1234567890 job=py-integration index=2 no-image`

kevin: trying `@ci-bot rerun run=1234567890 job=py-integration index=2 no-image` now.

ci-bot: Queued targeted rerun for run 1234567890 (job=py-integration index=2). no-image=true. New run: 1234567999. Preserving docker layers and KV cache.

anna: if this flakes again, consider a small bisect: rerun the matrix with `TEST_SEED` variations and `--repeat=5` to surface nondeterminism. Also add a short extra wait in db-setup fixture.

kevin: rerun passed! :tada: looks like transient. I'll open a follow-up PR to add a slightly longer wait and better error message.

sam: pro tip: if you ever want to force rebuild only (no tests) use: 
```
./ci tools rebuild --only-images --tag=pr-4321
```
but avoid unless image changes are expected.

maya: adding a task to the incident board: flaky db-setup -> assigning to @kevin.

kevin: thanks all, will keep an eye on the next couple CI runs.
